context: Two teens plan a school trip
purpose: Teach: ぢ/四つ/十一月/建てる/身内/本名/瀬/山中

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 十一月の修学旅行、山中湖、行くんだって。
lines.en: We're actually going to Lake Yamanaka for the November school trip.
lines.style: Bright, immediate opening. Slightly conspiratorial tone — sharing something she's been thinking about. Natural enthusiasm without overselling. Leans into the place name like it matters.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいな。仮設のロッジ、四つ建てるって聞いた。
lines.en: That sounds nice. I heard they're setting up four temporary lodges.
lines.style: Genuinely interested, appreciative. Measured pace. No big performance — just the tone of someone who's been thinking about the logistics and finds it satisfying.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 生徒名簿、本名で記入だよね。
lines.en: The roster's supposed to be filled out with our real names, right?
lines.style: Light test in the voice — curious about whether he's thought this through. Slight uptick at the end of 'right' like she's checking his reaction. Not confrontational, just observant.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。先生は身内みたいに親しいけど、書類は正式に。
lines.en: Yeah. The teachers feel pretty close to us, but the paperwork's got to be official.
lines.style: Steady, acknowledging the practical reality. A small shrug in the voice. Matter-of-fact but not dismissive — he understands both sides without needing to explain why.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 川の瀬まで歩く時間、楽しみ。
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to walking out to the shallows.
lines.style: Genuine warmth underneath. Eyes brighten in the voice. The kind of specific joy that comes from picturing something clearly. Slight lift on the final word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、最近ぢが悪化して、出てこられないらしい。
lines.en: My grandfather's hemorrhoids have gotten worse — he won't be able to make it.
lines.style: Flat, matter-of-fact delivery. No embarrassment performing, just stating fact. Slight resignation underneath. The tone of someone used to adult bodies having inconvenient problems. Quiet exhale at the end.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.en: We should pick up a souvenir for him on the way back.
lines.style: Soft landing. Genuinely considerate — not performative kindness, just the natural next thought. Warm closing energy. Slight smile in the voice.
